column1: # Common Arabic given names and their usual Latin spellings (English, French and
# Maghreb, Gulf, Turkish). Hand-written for nameproof, Apache-2.0. One name per line:
# Arabic<TAB>comma-separated spellings. Spellings are written lower case without
# accents, spaces, hyphens or apostrophes ("Abdel Kader" -> abdelkader). A spelling
# listed under two names (hamid) is ambiguous on purpose.
